DATABASE_MISMATCH: Connected database does not match configuration.
UNSUPPORTED_SERVER: PostgreSQL server 12 or newer is required.
SCHEMA_REQUIRED: Inspect schema before opening a transaction.
TX_FAILED: Transaction failed; roll back before continuing.
ACTIVE_TRANSACTION: Resolve the transaction before closing this handle.
RESULT_LIMIT: Result exceeds configured limits; execution may have taken effect.
COPY_UNSUPPORTED: COPY streaming is unsupported; connection disposed.
CANCELLED: Request cancelled; execution may have taken effect.
DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: Request deadline exceeded; execution may have taken effect.
CONNECTION_LOST: Connection lost; operation outcome may be unknown.
COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Commit outcome is unknown; do not retry automatically.
